# Bundled libraries

Copied here (not loaded from a CDN) so the site keeps working for years.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client-zip.js` | [client-zip](https://github.com/Touffy/client-zip) | 2.5.1 | MIT (`client-zip.LICENSE.txt`) |
| `qrcode.mjs` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) | 2.0.4 | MIT (header of the file) |
| `fonts/*.woff2` | [Cormorant Garamond](https://github.com/CatharsisFonts/Cormorant) via Fontsource | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |
